scope: Targeted post-extraction: documented scientific-name, diagnostic, measurement, and interpretation conflicts only; no full re-extraction
method: Inspected all 16 research batch records, their holds and source-status fields; original species inventory retained; verified identified conflicts against FNA, Kew, ITIS and original 1999 flora. No BONAP or distribution audits.
finalization_definition: Finalized only the documented ISSUE for these species, not claimed entire species morphology or publication fully audited

resolved.resolution: Retain Sida abutilifolia Mill. as accepted; 1999 Sida abutifolia Mill. is synonym/orthographic alternate, not a distinct species.

Retain Linum berlandieri species from FNA; 1999 L. rigidum var. berlandieri denotes historical alternative rank, not an additional inventory taxon; retain 1999 opaque thick-wall capsule diagnosis as varietal context.

FNA treats Linum rigidum and L. berlandieri separately. For L. rigidum, 1999 var. rigidum's thin translucent capsule is variety-context only; avoid transferring L. berlandieri diagnostics into the species record.

1999 key >9:1 distal-leaf proportion vs FNA >6:1 are source-specific ranges/key thresholds. Store both with provenance; when field filtering, use broader FNA species descriptive limit, not mutually contradictory asserted measurements.
evidence: Diggs et al. 1999 Euphorbiaceae p.592 key; verify exact page against original record before literal publication

resolved.resolution: 1999 typical conspicuous longer hairs vs FNA 'usually villous, sometimes glabrous'. Glabrous variants explicitly valid; hair presence cannot be hard exclusion.
FNA white petals fade red, reconciling older flora pink/red notes as flower-age/color-stage observations; distinguish fresh anthesis from senescent corolla.
evidence: Historical Gaura treatment in Diggs et al. 1999; no unsupported printed-page interpolation

resolved.resolution: Keep accepted Oenothera glaucifolia and historical printed Stenosiphon linifolius; POWO uses Stenosiphon linifolium. Both old epithet spellings connect to current O. glaucifolia, but preserve exact publication spelling per source.

FNA confirms mature fruit frequently with only 1 carpel, a documented species-level exception to common 3-carpellate genus character. Capsule 6.5–7 mm wide in FNA. Do not force generic statement on species.
evidence: Diggs et al. 1999 p.616 generic Tragia account

resolved.resolution: FNA supplies staminate pedicel 1.3–1.6 mm (persistent base 0.2–0.4 mm), pistillate pedicel 2–3 mm in fruit and diagnostic dark stems, coarse leaves, staminal filaments connate about half their length; 1999 flora absence does not invalidate modern species.

Both accounts agree petiole glands absent; FNA confirms nectaries on ABAXIAL LEAF BLADE, which is a different location and does not contradict glandless petioles. Keep 1999 1–3 mm floral bracts and knobbed corona diagnosis.

FNA provides 7–8 mericarps, reticulate persistent lateral walls, pair of terminal empty horns, fruit ca. 5 mm; blades 2–5(–8) cm with dense stellate pubescence underneath, single axillary flowers, nonreflexed petals. These complete previously missing characteristics.

FNA leaf blades up to 7 cm, stipules about 2 mm, 6 mm puberulent schizocarp, 4 mm spineless dorsally keeled reticulate mericarps; confirmed flowers sometimes cleistogamous. Do not label all flowers open/showy.
Retain Feijoa sellowiana as accepted under POWO; Acca sellowiana is synonym there but accepted by ITIS. Alternative taxonomic treatment noted, not a biological morphology discrepancy.
Retain Pombalia verticillata as modern accepted in repository; map 1999 Hybanthus verticillatus and H. linearis synonym entries; historical morphology source page 1061 valid for concept.

citation_page_review.source_scope_note: Page list applies to identified reconciliation cases or original related treatments; FNA-only sources marked without fabricated printed page. Potential Euphorbia angusta 1999 key location must be rechecked prior to citing exact page.

preservation: New research-only file; no prior files, site, credits, images, or taxon master records modified.
stop_condition: One pass only. Remaining documented issues need new cited evidence or specimen-level review, not automatic repeat audits.
